title: Co-designed muscle–tendon–bone architecture
scope: integrated biological or internal bioengineered augmentation
test: Quantify joint moment after strength, stress, fatigue, mass and safety constraints

title: Predictive sensorimotor architecture
test: Test latency-accuracy tradeoff on unexpected events with controlled tasks

title: Novel internally integrated sensory modalities
scope: new physical transducers and neural coding
test: Demonstrate useful information transfer and discrimination distinct from ordinary cues

title: Integrated energy–oxygen–thermal optimization
test: Constrain continuous usable power with simultaneous oxygen and thermoregulation budgets

title: Regeneration and long-term maintenance system
scope: tissue repair, immune and tumor surveillance
test: Assess evidence for long-term recovery and comparative harm rates
